unvalidatedShort: Not enough history to replay — approving creates its rules switched off.

detail.title: Draft
detail.unvalidated: There was not enough history to replay this on the machine, so it is unvalidated. Approving creates its rules switched off; each can then be switched on here, and that choice is recorded.
detail.enableConfirm: Switch this rule on although it was never validated against history?
detail.approveConfirm: Approve this draft? It becomes live for the account.
detail.approveUnvalidatedConfirm: Approve this unvalidated draft? Its rules are created switched off.

propose.title: Propose a KPI
propose.intro: The platform assembles the KPI from your choice and checks it; it becomes a draft for your super admin to approve.
propose.noFormulas: No published formulas in the library.
propose.needTwoKpis: This machine needs at least two KPIs for a ratio.
